nullBaseline.causality: control outcome through the maximum declared horizon must be finalized strictly before the event decision
nullBaseline.focalEventExclusion: exclude control decision bars within plus-or-minus the maximum declared horizon of the same module:eventType family; unrelated technical events do not invalidate the focal-event null

nullBaseline.method: strict-prior exact-regime matched control without replacement within each focal module:eventType family

stabilityDefinition.selection: all observed groups retained without minimum-sample or sign filter
